example: Governments may abolish outdated rules when older policies block fair education and efficient public services.
当旧政策阻碍教育公平和公共服务效率时，政府可能会废除过时规则。
Schools should eliminate hidden barriers so rural students can access reliable online learning resources.
学校应消除隐性障碍，让农村学生能够获得可靠的线上学习资源。

aboriginal.zh: 原住民的；土著的；本土的
example: Environmental policies should respect aboriginal communities when protecting forests, rivers, and traditional farming areas.
环境政策在保护森林、河流和传统农耕区时，应尊重原住民社区。

indigenous.zh: 土著的；本土的；当地固有的
example: Conservation projects can protect indigenous species while also supporting local farmers and rural employment.
保护项目既可以保护本土物种，也可以支持当地农民和农村就业。
An abrupt policy change can disrupt food supply chains and make local markets unstable.
突然的政策变化可能扰乱食品供应链，并使本地市场变得不稳定。
A sudden price rise may hurt low-income families more severely than wealthy consumers.
突然涨价对低收入家庭的伤害可能比对富裕消费者更严重。

accommodate.zh: 容纳；适应；提供住宿；满足需要
example: Companies should accommodate older workers by offering flexible hours and safer working conditions.
公司应通过提供弹性工时和更安全的工作条件来适应老年员工。
Teachers must adapt teaching methods when mixed-ability classes include students with different needs.
当混合能力班包含需求不同的学生时，教师必须调整教学方法。
Public transport reform can accomplish long-term goals if cities invest consistently.
如果城市持续投资，公共交通改革可以实现长期目标。
Governments cannot achieve educational equality unless rural schools receive stable funding and qualified teachers.
除非农村学校获得稳定经费和合格教师，否则政府无法实现教育公平。
Credit cards can make young consumers accumulate debt before they understand long-term interest costs.
信用卡可能让年轻消费者在理解长期利息成本前就积累债务。
Large events may amass debts when stadiums cost more than expected and remain unused.
当体育场成本超过预期且赛后闲置时，大型赛事可能积累债务。
Workers need to acquire practical skills when robots replace routine jobs in factories.
当机器人取代工厂中的常规工作时，工人需要获得实用技能。
Patients should obtain medical advice from professionals instead of relying only on search results.
患者应从专业人士那里获得医疗建议，而不是只依赖搜索结果。
An adaptable workforce is crucial when automation changes job requirements faster than schools respond.
当自动化改变岗位要求的速度快于学校响应速度时，适应力强的劳动力很关键。

versatile.zh: 多功能的；多才多艺的；灵活的
example: Versatile technology can support online education, remote work, and public healthcare together.
多功能技术可以同时支持线上教育、远程办公和公共医疗。
Adjacent cities can share public transport systems to reduce congestion and housing pressure.
邻近城市可以共享公共交通系统，以减少拥堵和住房压力。
Neighboring countries may cooperate on food imports when climate shocks threaten regional supply.
当气候冲击威胁区域供应时，邻国可能在食品进口上合作。
Families may adjust spending habits when credit card interest becomes difficult to manage.
当信用卡利息变得难以管理时，家庭可能会调整消费习惯。
Schools should modify teaching materials when students from different backgrounds share the same classroom.
当不同背景的学生在同一间教室学习时，学校应修改教材。
Local governments must administer public funds carefully when hosting expensive international events.
地方政府在举办昂贵的国际赛事时，必须谨慎管理公共资金。
Cities should enforce traffic rules when congestion increases and public transport remains insufficient.
当拥堵加剧且公共交通仍然不足时，城市应执行交通规则。
Many educators advocate mixed education because it reduces labeling and encourages peer support.
许多教育者提倡混合教育，因为它减少标签化并鼓励同伴互助。
Urban planners should champion public transport if they want to make large cities more livable.
如果城市规划者想让大城市更宜居，就应支持公共交通。
More private cars will aggravate urban congestion unless cities expand reliable public transport.
除非城市扩建可靠的公共交通，否则更多私家车会加剧城市拥堵。
Unequal access to online healthcare may exacerbate inequality between urban and rural patients.
线上医疗可及性不平等可能加剧城乡患者之间的不平等。
An international agreement can help countries manage food imports during climate-related supply shocks.
国际协议可以帮助各国在气候相关供应冲击期间管理食品进口。
Broad consensus is necessary before governments spend public money on international sporting events.
政府在把公共资金用于国际体育赛事之前，需要形成广泛共识。
Governments should align policy goals before expanding transport networks around overcrowded cities.
政府在扩建拥挤城市周边交通网络前，应先协调政策目标。
City councils must coordinate transport planning when surrounding towns absorb growing populations.
当周边城镇吸收不断增长的人口时，市议会必须协调交通规划。
Remote work can alleviate traffic pressure if companies allow employees to avoid peak-hour commuting.
如果公司允许员工避开高峰通勤，远程办公可以缓解交通压力。
Planting urban trees can mitigate climate risks and improve residents' daily comfort.
种植城市树木可以减轻气候风险，并改善居民的日常舒适度。
A politician may allude to hidden costs without directly opposing an international event.
政治人物可能会暗示隐性成本，而不直接反对国际赛事。
Doctors should refer to previous evidence before giving online medical advice to anxious patients.
医生在给焦虑患者提供线上医疗建议前，应参考先前证据。
Credit cards can alter consumption patterns by encouraging people to buy before they save.
信用卡可能通过鼓励人们先消费后储蓄来改变消费模式。
Robots may transform public services when repetitive tasks can be completed faster and more accurately.
当重复性任务能被更快、更准确地完成时，机器人可能改变公共服务。
Small towns may amalgamate local services when populations decline and budgets become tighter.
当人口下降且预算更紧时，小城镇可能会合并地方服务。
Governments sometimes merge public agencies to reduce administrative costs and avoid duplicated work.
政府有时会合并公共机构，以降低行政成本并避免重复工作。
Better housing policy can ameliorate living conditions for residents in overcrowded cities.
更好的住房政策可以改善拥挤城市居民的生活条件。
Expanding clinics can improve medical access for older people with longer retirement periods.
扩建诊所可以改善退休期更长的老年人的医疗可及性。
Researchers should analyze survey data before claiming that mixed-ability classes improve confidence.
研究者在声称混合能力班能提升自信之前，应分析调查数据。
Citizens should scrutinize public spending carefully before supporting expensive international sporting events.
市民在支持昂贵的国际体育赛事之前，应仔细审查公共支出。
Poor planning can antagonize local residents when stadium construction raises rent and disrupts daily life.
当场馆建设推高房租并扰乱日常生活时，糟糕规划可能激怒当地居民。
High credit card fees may provoke public anger when young borrowers fall into debt.
当年轻借款人陷入债务时，高额信用卡费用可能激起公众愤怒。
Urban planners should anticipate future demand before expanding roads, housing, and public transport.
城市规划者在扩建道路、住房和公共交通前，应预判未来需求。
Governments must foresee long-term costs before building stadiums that may remain unused.
政府在建设可能闲置的体育场前，必须预见长期成本。
Antiquated teaching methods cannot prepare students for digital jobs or rapidly changing workplaces.
过时的教学方法无法让学生为数字化岗位或快速变化的职场做好准备。
Outdated infrastructure makes large cities less livable even when economic opportunities remain strong.
即使经济机会仍然很强，过时基础设施也会让大城市更不宜居。
Public apathy can allow wasteful projects to continue without serious criticism or debate.
公众冷漠可能让浪费性的项目在缺乏严肃批评和讨论的情况下继续推进。
Social indifference toward older workers may make longer retirement periods more difficult.
社会对老年劳动者的冷漠可能让更长的退休期变得更困难。
Governments should appoint independent experts before making decisions about online healthcare regulation.
政府在制定线上医疗监管决策之前，应任命独立专家。
Cities can designate green areas to reduce noise, pollution, and daily pressure.
城市可以指定绿地区域，以减少噪音、污染和日常压力。
Consumers often fail to apprehend complex risks when online medical information sounds confident.
当线上医疗信息听起来很自信时，消费者常常无法理解复杂风险。
Patients need to comprehend medical advice before deciding whether online information is reliable.
患者在判断线上信息是否可靠之前，需要理解医疗建议。
Apprehensive parents may strongly oppose ability grouping if it damages children's confidence.
如果按能力分班会伤害孩子自信，忧虑的父母可能强烈反对它。
Anxious patients may easily misread online symptoms and delay professional diagnosis during treatment.
焦虑患者在治疗期间可能容易误读线上症状，并延误专业诊断。
Arbitrary rules in schools may label children unfairly and reduce their confidence.
学校中的任意规则可能不公平地给孩子贴标签，并降低他们的自信。

haphazard.zh: 杂乱的；随意的；无计划的
example: Haphazard planning can make public transport inefficient and increase daily commuting stress.
杂乱规划会让公共交通低效，并增加日常通勤压力。
Citizens should articulate public concerns before governments spend heavily on international events.
在政府大量花钱举办国际赛事之前，市民应表达公众担忧。
Young consumers may express strong concern when credit card fees become difficult to understand.
当信用卡费用变得难以理解时，年轻消费者可能表达强烈担忧。
Artificial intelligence can improve efficiency, but it may also replace repetitive jobs.
人工智能可以提高效率，但也可能取代重复性工作。
Synthetic food may reduce pressure on farmland if consumers accept new production methods.
如果消费者接受新的生产方式，合成食品可能减轻农田压力。
Housing prices may ascend rapidly when too many people move into large cities.
当太多人迁入大城市时，房价可能快速上升。
Living costs often rise sharply when housing demand exceeds available supply in major cities.
当大城市住房需求超过可用供应时，生活成本往往会急剧上升。
Researchers must assemble evidence before evaluating whether online education helps disadvantaged students.
研究者在评估线上教育是否帮助弱势学生前，必须汇集证据。
Governments should compile statistics before deciding whether an ageing population threatens public services.
政府在判断老龄化人口是否威胁公共服务前，应汇编统计数据。
Public assent is difficult to obtain when major projects lack transparency and clear benefits.
当重大项目缺乏透明度和明确收益时，公众同意很难获得。
Doctors must obtain informed consent before using patient data in online healthcare systems.
医生在网络医疗系统中使用患者数据前，必须获得知情同意。
Workers should assert legal rights when automation threatens wages and job security.
当自动化威胁工资和就业保障时，工人应主张合法权利。
Advertisers often claim health benefits even when scientific evidence remains weak or incomplete.
即使科学证据仍然薄弱或不完整，广告商也常常声称产品有健康益处。
Authorities should assess environmental impact before approving new roads through rural areas.
当局在批准穿过农村地区的新道路前，应评估环境影响。
Schools should evaluate teaching quality before replacing traditional lessons with online platforms.
学校在用线上平台替代传统课程前，应评估教学质量。
Immigrants may assimilate into society more easily when schools support language learning.
当学校支持语言学习时，移民可能更容易融入社会。
Teachers can integrate online resources without abandoning books, handwriting, or classroom discussion.
教师可以整合线上资源，而不放弃书本、手写和课堂讨论。
Clearer regulation can attenuate harmful effects of misleading online medical advice on patients.
更清晰的监管可以减弱误导性线上医疗建议对患者的有害影响。
Poor transparency can diminish public trust in government spending on major events.
透明度不足可能削弱公众对政府大型赛事支出的信任。
Tourism can offer authentic cultural experiences when local communities control how traditions are presented.
当当地社区掌控传统呈现方式时，旅游业可以提供真实的文化体验。
Genuine progress in education requires funding, trained teachers, and stable access to technology.
教育上的真正进步需要资金、受过训练的教师和稳定的技术可及性。
Autonomous robots may improve productivity, but they can also reduce demand for workers.
自主机器人可能提高生产率，但也可能减少对工人的需求。
Independent research is necessary when companies fund studies about their own products.
当公司资助关于自身产品的研究时，独立研究是必要的。
Governments can avert a crisis by preparing food reserves before supply chains fail.
政府可以在供应链失灵前准备粮食储备，以避免危机。
Professional diagnosis can prevent misdiagnosis when patients rely too heavily on online searches.
当患者过度依赖网络搜索时，专业诊断可以防止误诊。

barren.zh: 贫瘠的；荒芜的；无成果的
example: Barren land may become productive if farmers receive better irrigation and modern equipment.
如果农民获得更好的灌溉和现代设备，贫瘠土地可能变得有生产力。
A desolate village can recover if transport links bring jobs and public services.
如果交通连接带来工作和公共服务，荒凉村庄可以恢复。
Bewildered patients may choose unsafe treatments when online information contradicts medical advice.
当网络信息与医疗建议相矛盾时，困惑患者可能选择不安全的治疗。
Perplexed students need clearer explanations when technology replaces traditional classroom routines too quickly.
当技术过快取代传统课堂流程时，困惑学生需要更清楚的解释。
Biased reporting can distort public views on crime, immigration, and government spending.
有偏见的报道可能扭曲公众对犯罪、移民和政府支出的看法。
Prejudiced hiring can reduce workplace diversity and limit women's career opportunities in companies.
有偏见的招聘会降低职场多样性，并限制女性在公司的职业机会。
Reducing food imports may bolster local farming if consumers still have enough choice.
如果消费者仍有足够选择，减少食品进口可能支持本地农业。
Ability grouping may reinforce social inequality if weaker students receive fewer resources.
如果较弱学生获得更少资源，按能力分班可能强化社会不平等。
Students can brainstorm solutions before writing essays about traffic congestion or pollution.
学生可以在写交通拥堵或污染类作文前集思广益想方案。
Governments must contemplate retirement reform as life expectancy rises and pension systems face pressure.
随着预期寿命上升、养老金体系承压，政府必须考虑退休改革。
Online platforms may breach privacy rules if they collect patient data without consent.
如果线上平台未经同意收集患者数据，就可能违反隐私规则。
Companies violate personal privacy when they sell user data without clear permission.
公司未经明确许可出售用户数据时，会侵犯个人隐私。
Online shopping may burgeon rapidly when delivery services become cheaper and more reliable.
当快递服务更便宜、更可靠时，网购可能快速发展。
Local businesses can flourish in cities when public transport brings more customers.
当公共交通带来更多顾客时，本地商业可以在城市中繁荣。
Transparent budgets can buttress public trust before governments build expensive stadiums for events.
透明预算可以在政府为赛事建设昂贵体育场前支撑公众信任。
Governments should support local farmers if they want to reduce reliance on food imports.
如果政府想减少对食品进口的依赖，就应支持本地农民。
Some companies bypass safety checks to cut costs, which can endanger consumers.
一些公司为削减成本绕过安全检查，这可能危及消费者。
Digital platforms may circumvent regulations when laws fail to keep pace with technology.
当法律未能跟上技术发展时，数字平台可能规避监管。
A cautious approach is necessary when governments regulate online medical advice and patient data.
当政府监管线上医疗建议和患者数据时，谨慎的方法是必要的。
Prudent spending matters when cities consider expensive stadiums and long-term maintenance costs.
当城市考虑昂贵体育场和长期维护成本时，审慎支出很重要。
Factories may cease production when energy costs rise and supply chains become unstable.
当能源成本上涨且供应链变得不稳定时，工厂可能停止生产。
Authorities should terminate harmful practices when companies repeatedly violate safety standards in factories.
当公司在工厂反复违反安全标准时，当局应终止有害做法。
International events can celebrate national success, but they may also strain public budgets.
国际赛事可以庆祝国家成功，但也可能加重公共预算压力。
Museums can commemorate historical events while helping visitors understand cultural identity and national memory.
博物馆可以纪念历史事件，同时帮助游客理解文化身份和民族记忆。
Teaching mixed-ability classes is challenging when students learn at very different speeds.
当学生学习速度差异很大时，教授混合能力班是有挑战性的。

formidable.zh: 强大的；艰巨的；令人敬畏的
example: Reducing food imports can be a formidable challenge for countries with limited farmland.
对耕地有限的国家来说，减少食品进口可能是巨大挑战。
Doctors should clarify medical advice when patients rely on confusing online information.
当患者依赖令人困惑的网络信息时，医生应澄清医疗建议。
Researchers can elucidate complex causes of urban stress by studying housing, transport, and income.
研究者可以通过研究住房、交通和收入来阐明城市压力的复杂原因。
New housing projects may clash with local interests when communities fear overcrowding.
当社区担心过度拥挤时，新住房项目可能与地方利益冲突。
Public health advice may conflict with online rumours during a medical crisis.
在医疗危机期间，公共卫生建议可能与网络谣言冲突。
A clever solution can reduce traffic without forcing every resident to stop driving.
巧妙方案可以减少交通拥堵，而不强迫每个居民停止开车。
An ingenious solution can make public transport cheaper, faster, and easier to use.
巧妙解决方案可以让公共交通更便宜、更快捷、更容易使用。
Public anger may reach a climax when housing costs rise faster than wages.
当住房成本上涨速度快于工资时，公众愤怒可能达到高潮。
A successful policy may be the culmination of research, public debate, and careful funding.
成功政策可能是研究、公众讨论和谨慎拨款的最终结果。

coherent.zh: 连贯的；一致的；条理清楚的
example: A coherent policy should connect housing, transport, and employment rather than treat them separately.
连贯政策应连接住房、交通和就业，而不是把它们分开处理。
A cohesive community can help older people avoid loneliness and maintain healthier routines.
有凝聚力的社区可以帮助老年人避免孤独，并保持更健康的生活习惯。
Public health agencies can collaborate with schools to teach children healthier habits.
公共卫生机构可以与学校合作，教孩子更健康的习惯。
Neighboring countries should cooperate on climate policy when food supplies become unstable.
当食品供应变得不稳定时，邻国应在气候政策上合作。
Schools can combine online and offline learning without abandoning classroom interaction or handwriting.
学校可以结合线上和线下学习，而不放弃课堂互动或手写训练。
Governments may unify standards to make online healthcare safer and more reliable.
政府可以统一标准，让线上医疗更安全、更可靠。
Reliable evidence should precede major reform, especially when children may be affected.
可靠证据应先于重大改革，尤其是在儿童可能受影响时。
Some traditional farming methods antedate modern technology but still protect local ecosystems.
一些传统农业方法早于现代技术，但仍能保护当地生态系统。
Cities should commence construction only after assessing environmental impacts and housing pressure.
城市只有在评估环境影响和住房压力后才应开始建设。
Schools can initiate public discussion before changing how students are grouped by ability.
学校在改变学生按能力分组方式前，可以发起公共讨论。
Providing free schooling in poor areas is a commendable effort toward equality.
在贫困地区提供免费教育，是迈向平等的可嘉努力。
It is praiseworthy when companies train older workers instead of replacing them immediately.
当公司培训老年员工而不是立刻替换他们时，这是值得赞扬的。
Doctors must communicate risks clearly so patients do not rely on misleading websites.
医生必须清楚传达风险，这样患者才不会依赖误导性网站。
News reports should convey public concern without exaggerating crime or creating panic.
新闻报道应传达公众担忧，而不是夸大犯罪或制造恐慌。
Online platforms and classroom teaching can be compatible if teachers design balanced lessons.
如果教师设计平衡的课程，线上平台和课堂教学可以相容。
A harmonious society requires fair rules, basic welfare, and respect for different groups.
和谐社会需要公平规则、基本福利以及对不同群体的尊重。
Rising healthcare costs may compel governments to reform pension and insurance systems.
不断上涨的医疗成本可能迫使政府改革养老金和保险体系。
New safety laws may oblige employers to protect workers from dangerous machines.
新的安全法律可能迫使用人单位保护工人免受危险机器伤害。
Governments should compensate local farmers if import policies damage their income and livelihoods.
如果进口政策损害当地农民收入和生计，政府应补偿他们。
Insurance systems should reimburse medical expenses quickly when older patients need long-term care.
当老年患者需要长期护理时，保险系统应快速报销医疗费用。
Ageing is a complex social problem involving healthcare, pensions, families, and employment.
老龄化是涉及医疗、养老金、家庭和就业的复杂社会问题。

intricate.zh: 复杂精细的；错综复杂的
example: An intricate transport network can reduce congestion if buses, trains, and cycling routes connect well.
如果公交、火车和自行车路线衔接良好，复杂交通网络可以减少拥堵。
A comprehensive healthcare system should combine prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and long-term care.
全面医疗体系应结合预防、诊断、治疗和长期护理。
Exhaustive research is needed before governments approve costly transport projects in crowded cities.
政府在拥挤城市批准昂贵交通项目前，需要详尽研究。
Cheap construction may compromise safety if cities rush to prepare for international events.
如果城市仓促筹备国际赛事，廉价建设可能损害安全。
False advertising can undermine public trust and encourage unhealthy consumption habits among children.
虚假广告会削弱公众信任，并鼓励儿童形成不健康消费习惯。
Researchers can conceive a solution by linking housing policy with transport planning.
研究者可以通过把住房政策与交通规划连接起来构想解决方案。
Students can conceptualize social change more clearly through concrete examples and topic vocabulary.
学生可以通过具体例子和话题词汇更清楚地概念化社会变化。
A concise explanation helps voters understand complex policies without reading long reports.
简明解释帮助选民不读长报告也能理解复杂政策。
A succinct policy brief can help citizens compare different transport proposals more easily.
简明政策简报可以帮助市民更容易比较不同交通方案。
Researchers cannot conclude that online learning works without comparing students' long-term outcomes.
研究者若不比较学生长期结果，就不能得出线上学习有效的结论。
Governments should finalize the plan only after public consultation and financial review.
政府只有在公众咨询和财务审查之后，才应最终确定计划。

concrete.zh: 具体的；实在的；混凝土的
example: A concrete solution to traffic congestion requires buses, cycling lanes, and better land use.
交通拥堵的具体解决方案需要公交、自行车道和更好的土地使用。

tangible.zh: 有形的；实际的；可感知的
example: Public transport projects should bring tangible benefits, not merely impressive speeches or statistics.
公共交通项目应带来实际好处，而不只是漂亮讲话或统计数据。
Doctors may concur with experts when online advice creates unnecessary anxiety among patients.
当网络建议在患者中制造不必要焦虑时，医生可能会同意专家观点。
Transport policy should accord with public interest rather than serve short-term political goals.
交通政策应符合公共利益，而不是服务于短期政治目标。
Teachers should confine discussion to evidence when students debate controversial social issues.
当学生讨论有争议的社会问题时，教师应将讨论限于证据。
Governments may restrict imports temporarily when domestic farmers face severe financial pressure.
当本地农民面临严重财务压力时，政府可能暂时限制进口。
Medical tests can confirm the diagnosis before patients follow advice from unreliable websites.
在患者听从不可靠网站建议之前，医学检测可以确认诊断。
Independent research can validate the results before governments use them to justify spending.
独立研究可以在政府用结果证明支出合理之前验证结果。
Health campaigns work better when public messages are congruent with medical evidence.
当公共宣传信息与医学证据一致时，健康宣传效果更好。
A corresponding increase in public transport is needed when cities build new housing.
当城市建设新住房时，需要相应增加公共交通。
Commentators should not conjecture about causes before investigators release reliable public evidence.
在调查人员公布可靠公共证据之前，评论者不应推测原因。
Investors may speculate on future trends when housing prices rise too quickly.
当房价上涨过快时，投资者可能推测未来趋势。
The conquest of disease depends on research, prevention, affordable healthcare, and public trust.
战胜疾病取决于研究、预防、可负担医疗和公众信任。
A technological triumph is meaningful only if it improves ordinary people's lives.
技术胜利只有在改善普通人生活时才有意义。
Ageing populations place considerable pressure on pensions, hospitals, families, and public budgets.
人口老龄化给养老金、医院、家庭和公共预算带来相当大压力。

substantial.zh: 大量的；实质性的；重要的
example: Substantial evidence is needed before governments change education systems for millions of children.
政府在改变数百万儿童的教育制度前，需要大量证据。
A balanced diet may comprise local products, imported food, and seasonal vegetables.
均衡饮食可以包括本地产品、进口食品和时令蔬菜。
Urban planning should encompass housing, transport, green space, and local employment opportunities.
城市规划应涵盖住房、交通、绿地和本地就业机会。
Consistent policy helps families plan education, housing, retirement, and long-term healthcare.
稳定政策帮助家庭规划教育、住房、退休和长期医疗。
Steady income allows older workers to maintain independence and reduce pressure on families.
稳定收入让老年劳动者保持独立，并减轻家庭压力。
Conspicuous consumption may increase debt when young people buy expensive status symbols.
当年轻人购买昂贵的地位象征时，炫耀性消费可能增加债务。
A noticeable improvement in public transport can make large cities more livable.
公共交通的明显改善可以让大城市更宜居。
High housing costs constitute a major threat to young workers' living standards.
高住房成本构成对年轻劳动者生活水平的重大威胁。
Experts from different fields should compose a committee on online healthcare regulation.
来自不同领域的专家应组成线上医疗监管委员会。
Courts should not construe silence as consent in cases involving personal data.
在涉及个人数据的案件中，法院不应将沉默理解为同意。
Researchers must interpret survey data carefully before recommending changes to education policy.
研究者在建议改变教育政策之前，必须仔细解读调查数据。
Households consume energy heavily when cities depend on private cars and inefficient housing.
当城市依赖私家车和低效住房时，家庭会大量消耗能源。
Mega-events can devour resources that might otherwise improve hospitals, schools, or housing.
大型赛事可能大量消耗本可用于改善医院、学校或住房的资源。
Contemporary education should prepare students for technology, cooperation, uncertainty, and constant change.
当代教育应让学生为技术、合作、不确定性和持续变化做好准备。
Modern medicine can extend life expectancy, but it also increases pressure on pensions.
现代医学可以延长预期寿命，但也会增加养老金压力。
Online rumours may contradict official data and confuse patients during public health crises.
在公共卫生危机期间，网络谣言可能与官方数据矛盾并让患者困惑。
Residents may oppose excessive spending when stadiums bring little long-term benefit.
当体育场几乎没有长期收益时，居民可能反对过度支出。
There is a policy contradiction when governments promote health but allow junk food advertising.
当政府一边促进健康、一边允许垃圾食品广告时，就存在政策矛盾。
The urban paradox is that cities offer jobs while making daily life stressful.
城市悖论在于，城市提供工作机会，却让日常生活充满压力。
Older workers can make an economic contribution if companies value their experience.
如果公司重视老年员工的经验，他们可以做出经济贡献。
Expert input is essential before schools redesign exams or ability-based classes.
学校重新设计考试或按能力分班之前，专家意见很重要。
Governments should convene public hearings before approving expensive urban redevelopment projects in crowded districts.
政府在批准拥挤地区昂贵的城市改造项目之前，应召开公开听证会。
Hospitals may summon emergency staff when online misinformation causes panic among patients.
当网络误导信息在患者中引发恐慌时，医院可能召集应急人员。
Conventional medicine remains necessary even when online health advice becomes widely available.
即使线上健康建议变得广泛可得，常规医学仍然必要。
An orthodox approach may fail when technology changes work faster than schools respond.
当技术改变工作的速度快于学校响应速度时，正统方法可能会失效。
Different transport policies may converge on a solution that reduces car dependence.
不同交通政策可能汇聚成一个减少汽车依赖的解决方案。
Small community groups can coalesce into a movement against wasteful public spending.
小型社区组织可以联合成反对浪费性公共支出的运动。
Public investment can counterbalance negative effects of automation by retraining displaced workers.
公共投资可以通过再培训被替代工人来抵消自动化的负面影响。
Green spaces can offset rising stress levels in densely populated urban areas.
绿地可以抵消高密度城市地区不断上升的压力水平。
Counterfeit medicine can endanger patients who cannot afford professional healthcare or reliable diagnosis.
假药可能危及负担不起专业医疗或可靠诊断的患者。
Fraudulent information about health products should be removed from online platforms quickly.
关于健康产品的虚假信息应迅速从线上平台移除。
Older employees may work differently from their younger counterparts but offer valuable experience.
老年员工的工作方式可能不同于年轻同行，但能提供宝贵经验。
Foreign qualifications should be recognized if they provide equivalent skills and training.
如果外国资格能提供同等技能和培训，就应获得认可。
Patients need credible evidence before trusting online advice about serious symptoms or treatments.
患者在相信关于严重症状或治疗的网络建议之前，需要可信证据。
A plausible explanation still needs evidence before it influences public policy or medical decisions.
貌似合理的解释在影响公共政策或医疗决定之前仍需要证据。
Congested roads waste time, increase stress, and reduce the appeal of city life.
拥堵道路浪费时间、增加压力，并降低城市生活的吸引力。
Overcrowded classrooms make it difficult for teachers to support weaker students effectively.
过度拥挤的教室让教师难以有效支持较弱学生。
Reliable public transport is a crucial factor in making large cities more livable.
可靠的公共交通是让大城市更宜居的关键因素。
Teachers play a pivotal role when students are divided by ability or mixed together.
当学生按能力分班或混合编班时，教师发挥关键作用。
Years of poor planning may culminate in a crisis when cities grow too quickly.
当城市增长过快时，多年规划不善可能最终导致危机。
Electricity demand may reach a peak when heatwaves make air conditioning essential.
当热浪使空调变得必不可少时，电力需求可能达到峰值。
Schools should cultivate habits of cooperation instead of ranking children too early.
学校应培养合作习惯，而不是过早给孩子排名。
Mixed education can nurture creativity because students learn from different abilities and backgrounds.
混合教育可以培养创造力，因为学生能从不同能力和背景中学习。
Cumbersome procedures can discourage patients from seeing doctors and push them toward online searches.
繁琐程序会阻碍患者看医生，并把他们推向网络搜索。
An unwieldy system can delay medical reimbursement and frustrate older patients repeatedly.
笨重系统会反复延误医疗报销，并让老年患者沮丧。
Governments may curtail spending when international events become more expensive than expected.
当国际赛事变得比预期更昂贵时，政府可能削减支出。
Central banks may restrain borrowing when credit card debt grows too quickly.
当信用卡债务增长过快时，央行可能抑制借贷。
Journalists should debunk false claims about miracle cures before they spread widely.
记者应在神奇疗法的虚假说法广泛传播前加以驳斥。
Researchers can refute an argument if evidence shows the policy harms students.
如果证据表明政策伤害学生，研究者可以反驳该论点。
Deliberate deceit in advertising can push consumers toward unsafe health products online.
广告中的蓄意欺骗会把消费者推向网络上的不安全健康产品。
Commercial duplicity becomes dangerous when companies hide risks from vulnerable consumers deliberately.
当公司故意向脆弱消费者隐瞒风险时，商业欺诈会变得危险。
Deceitful advertising can make children believe unhealthy food is necessary for happiness.
欺骗性广告会让儿童相信不健康食品是幸福所必需的。

treacherous.zh: 危险的；背叛的；不可靠的
example: A treacherous road can isolate rural communities from hospitals, schools, and markets.
危险道路会使农村社区与医院、学校和市场隔绝。
Deceptive advertising may encourage excessive consumption and increase household debt among young people.
欺骗性广告可能鼓励过度消费，并增加年轻人的家庭债务。
Misleading advice online can delay treatment and make minor illnesses more serious.
网络上的误导性建议会延误治疗，并使小病变得更严重。
Birth rates may decline sharply when housing costs and childcare costs keep rising.
当住房成本和育儿成本持续上涨时，出生率可能急剧下降。
Patients may refuse treatment if doctors fail to explain risks clearly enough.
如果医生未能足够清楚地解释风险，患者可能拒绝治疗。
Students can decode information better when teachers explain topic vocabulary before reading.
当教师在阅读前解释话题词汇时，学生能更好地解码信息。
Researchers must decipher complex data carefully before drawing conclusions about public health.
研究者在得出公共健康结论之前，必须仔细解读复杂数据。
Researchers can deduce causes from evidence only after excluding alternative explanations carefully.
研究者只有在仔细排除替代解释后，才能从证据推断原因。
Readers should infer meaning from context instead of translating every single word.
读者应从语境推断含义，而不是翻译每一个单词。
Courts may deem it necessary to protect users' data from commercial abuse.
法院可能认为有必要保护用户数据免受商业滥用。
Employers should regard robots as tools rather than replacements for all workers.
雇主应将机器人视为工具，而不是所有工人的替代品。
Nutritional deficiency may increase when poor families cannot afford fresh local food.
当贫困家庭买不起新鲜本地食物时，营养缺乏可能增加。
Insufficiency of resources can make rural healthcare slower, weaker, and less reliable.
资源不足会让农村医疗更慢、更弱且更不可靠。

definitive.zh: 决定性的；最终的；权威的
example: Definitive evidence is needed before schools adopt strict ability grouping policies nationwide.
学校在全国范围内采用严格按能力分班政策之前，需要决定性证据。
Decisive action is necessary when pollution threatens public health in crowded cities.
当污染威胁拥挤城市中的公共健康时，果断行动是必要的。
Industrial pollution can degrade soil quality and weaken local food production systems.
工业污染会降低土壤质量，并削弱本地食品生产系统。
Public health may deteriorate rapidly when hospitals are overcrowded and seriously underfunded.
当医院过度拥挤且资金严重不足时，公共健康可能迅速恶化。
Governments should delineate responsibilities clearly when several agencies manage urban transport together.
当多个机构共同管理城市交通时，政府应清楚划分责任。
Media reports can depict urban pressure through stories about rent and commuting.
媒体报道可以通过房租和通勤故事描绘城市压力。
Survey data can demonstrate public concern about housing, transport, pollution, and employment.
调查数据可以显示公众对住房、交通、污染和就业的担忧。
Social inequality may manifest clearly when schools receive very different resources and funding.
当学校获得的资源和经费差异很大时，社会不平等可能明显显现。
A high price does not always denote better quality or greater safety.
高价格并不总是表示更好质量或更高安全性。
Local food can signify cultural identity as well as economic independence for communities.
本地食物既可以象征社区的文化身份，也可以象征经济独立。
Mega-events can deplete resources that should fund hospitals and public transport.
大型赛事可能耗尽本应资助医院和公共交通的资源。
Long commutes can exhaust workers before they even begin their jobs each morning.
长通勤会在工人每天早晨开始工作前就让他们疲惫不堪。
Local communities may derive income from tourism when cultural sites are protected.
当文化遗址受到保护时，当地社区可以从旅游中获得收入。
Researchers must detach from emotion when evaluating controversial education policies and evidence.
研究者在评估有争议的教育政策和证据时，必须脱离情绪。
Schools should separate facts from opinions when students discuss social media claims.
当学生讨论社交媒体说法时，学校应区分事实和观点。
High fines can be a strong deterrent against illegal dumping in cities.
高额罚款可以成为阻止城市非法倾倒垃圾的强大威慑。
High parking fees can create a strong disincentive for driving into city centres.
高停车费会形成强负激励，减少开车进入市中心。
Citizens may detest corruption when public money is wasted on empty stadiums.
当公共资金被浪费在空置体育场上时，市民可能憎恶腐败。
Taxpayers may loathe wasteful spending when basic services remain badly underfunded for years.
当基本服务多年资金严重不足时，纳税人可能厌恶浪费性支出。
Excessive screen time can be detrimental to health when children stop exercising.
当儿童停止运动时，过多屏幕时间可能对健康有害。
Harmful substances in polluted air can worsen children's health over time significantly.
污染空气中的有害物质会随着时间显著恶化儿童健康。
Mixed-ability classes include students with different needs, speeds, and levels of confidence.
混合能力班包含需求、速度和自信水平不同的学生。
Divergent views on food imports often reflect different economic interests and cultural habits.
对食品进口的不同观点常常反映不同经济利益和文化习惯。
Governments face a policy dilemma when economic growth conflicts with environmental protection.
当经济增长与环境保护冲突时，政府面临政策困境。
Parents face a serious quandary when online learning saves time but weakens social interaction.
当线上学习节省时间却削弱社交互动时，父母面临严重困境。
Readers must discern hidden risks when websites offer medical advice without evidence.
当网站在没有证据的情况下提供医疗建议时，读者必须识别隐藏风险。
Consumers may perceive risk differently when food labels are unclear or misleading.
当食品标签不清楚或具有误导性时，消费者可能会以不同方式感知风险。
Organizers should disclose hidden costs before cities bid for international sporting events.
城市申办国际体育赛事之前，组织者应披露隐性成本。
Survey data can reveal hidden problems in online education and rural healthcare.
调查数据可以揭示线上教育和农村医疗中的隐藏问题。
A data discrepancy may reveal that official statistics overlook many informal workers.
数据差异可能揭示官方统计忽视了许多非正式劳动者。
Policy inconsistency makes it difficult for families to plan education and housing.
政策不一致让家庭难以规划教育和住房。
Employers should not discriminate against older workers when hiring for skilled positions.
雇主在招聘技术岗位时，不应歧视老年劳动者。
Students must distinguish facts from opinions when reading social media posts online.
学生在线阅读社交媒体帖子时，必须区分事实和观点。
Disorderly traffic can make large cities stressful and unsafe for pedestrians daily.
混乱交通每天都会让大城市对行人而言压力大且不安全。
Chaotic traffic discourages cycling and makes public space less attractive for families.
混乱交通会削弱骑车意愿，并让公共空间对家庭不那么有吸引力。
Developing smaller cities can disperse population pressure away from overcrowded capitals gradually.
发展较小城市可以逐步把人口压力从过度拥挤的首都分散出去。
Poor planning may scatter resources across too many unfinished urban projects unnecessarily.
糟糕规划可能把资源不必要地分散到太多未完成的城市项目上。
Companies should not disregard safety rules simply to reduce production costs in factories.
公司不应仅仅为了降低工厂生产成本而忽视安全规则。
Officials should not dismiss concerns about pollution near schools, homes, and hospitals.
官员不应不理会学校、住宅和医院附近污染问题引发的担忧。
Public institutions should disseminate information quickly during health emergencies and natural disasters.
公共机构应在健康紧急事件和自然灾害期间快速传播信息。
Misinformation can spread quickly when people fear illness and distrust professional doctors.
当人们害怕疾病并不信任专业医生时，错误信息会快速传播。
Local food has distinct cultural value that imported products cannot fully replace.
本地食物具有进口产品无法完全替代的明显文化价值。
Small countries may have unique advantages in tourism, culture, and local food.
小国可能在旅游、文化和本地食物方面拥有独特优势。
Distinguished scholars often question simple solutions to complex education problems and social inequality.
杰出学者常常质疑复杂教育问题和社会不平等的简单解决方案。
Eminent scientists can help the public understand climate risks without exaggeration or panic.
杰出科学家可以帮助公众在不夸大、不恐慌的情况下理解气候风险。
Sensational headlines can distort public debate about crime, immigration, and public spending.
煽动性标题会扭曲关于犯罪、移民和公共支出的公共讨论。
Campaigners should not misrepresent evidence to gain support for expensive public projects.
活动人士不应为了获得对昂贵公共项目的支持而歪曲证据。
Governments should distribute resources fairly between major cities and neglected rural regions.
政府应在大城市和被忽视的农村地区之间公平分配资源。
Schools need clear rules to allocate funding among students with different needs.
学校需要明确规则，把资金分配给不同需求的学生。
Public opinions may diverge sharply when policies affect housing costs very differently.
当政策对住房成本产生很不一样的影响时，公众意见可能明显分歧。
Officials should not deviate from standards when inspecting food safety in markets.
官员在市场中检查食品安全时不应偏离标准。
Bike lanes can divert traffic away from crowded roads and improve air quality.
自行车道可以把交通从拥挤道路转移出去，并改善空气质量。
Governments can redirect funding from empty stadiums to hospitals, schools, and housing.
政府可以把资金从空置体育场转移到医院、学校和住房。
Cars still play a dominant role in many crowded and polluted cities.
汽车在许多拥挤且污染严重的城市中仍然发挥主导作用。
The prevailing view may change when people see the hidden costs of mega-events.
当人们看到大型赛事的隐性成本时，主流观点可能改变。
A few large platforms can dominate public debate by controlling information flows.
少数大型平台可以通过控制信息流来主导公共讨论。
The glamour of international events can overshadow local needs for housing and healthcare.
国际赛事的光环可能掩盖本地对住房和医疗的需求。

dormant.zh: 休眠的；潜伏的；不活跃的
example: A dormant account can still create privacy risks if personal data remains stored.
如果个人数据仍被保存，休眠账户仍可能造成隐私风险。
An inactive lifestyle can increase health risks when children spend too much time online.
当儿童花太多时间上网时，不活跃的生活方式会增加健康风险。

doubtful.zh: 怀疑的；不确定的；可疑的
example: A doubtful claim about medicine should not influence patients without proper testing.
没有适当检测时，关于药物的可疑说法不应影响患者。
Dubious evidence should not justify expensive policies that affect millions of families.
可疑证据不应为影响数百万家庭的昂贵政策提供正当性。
Drastic measures may be necessary when pollution threatens children's health in cities.
当污染威胁城市中儿童健康时，严厉措施可能是必要的。
Radical reform may fail if citizens do not understand its long-term benefits.
如果市民不理解长期收益，激进改革可能会失败。
Cities need durable solutions to housing shortages, not temporary slogans or projects.
城市需要住房短缺的持久解决方案，而不是临时口号或项目。
A resilient community can recover faster after floods, unemployment, or public health crises.
有韧性的社区能在洪水、失业或公共卫生危机后更快恢复。
Longer retirement duration requires stronger pension systems and better healthcare planning nationwide.
更长退休期需要全国范围内更强的养老金体系和更好的医疗规划。
The length of retirement increases when people live longer than previous generations.
当人们比前几代活得更久时，退休时长会增加。
Local farming may dwindle rapidly if cheap imports dominate the market completely.
如果廉价进口食品完全主导市场，本地农业可能快速萎缩。
Eager students may benefit more when teachers offer challenging but clear materials.
当教师提供有挑战但清晰的材料时，热切的学生可能受益更多。
A keen interest in reading helps students build vocabulary through repeated exposure.
对阅读的浓厚兴趣帮助学生通过反复接触积累词汇。
Earnest discussion is needed before schools change how children are grouped by ability.
学校改变儿童按能力分组方式之前，需要认真讨论。
A sincere apology matters when public officials ignore residents' environmental concerns repeatedly.
当公职人员反复忽视居民的环境担忧时，真诚道歉很重要。
An eccentric idea may become useful if it solves a real problem.
如果古怪想法能解决真实问题，它可能变得有用。
Unconventional methods may help students who struggle in ordinary classrooms and exams.
非传统方法可能帮助在普通课堂和考试中吃力的学生。
Economic pressure increases when housing, food, and transport costs rise together quickly.
当住房、食品和交通成本同时快速上涨时，经济压力会增加。
Financial support can help older workers remain independent after retirement for longer.
财务支持可以帮助老年劳动者在退休后更长久地保持独立。
Effective policy should reduce congestion without simply pushing problems into neighbouring areas.
有效政策应减少拥堵，而不是简单把问题推到邻近地区。
Efficient public transport can reduce commuting time and improve urban life significantly.
高效公共交通可以显著减少通勤时间并改善城市生活。
An elaborate plan may still fail if funding is unstable or insufficient.
如果资金不稳定或不足，详尽计划仍可能失败。
A detailed report can reveal why public projects become more expensive than expected.
详细报告可以揭示公共项目为何变得比预期更加昂贵。
Education campaigns can elevate public awareness of climate risks and food security.
教育宣传可以提升公众对气候风险和粮食安全的意识。
Schools can raise awareness of online misinformation through reading lessons and discussion.
学校可以通过阅读课和讨论提高学生对网络误导信息的意识。
Eligible applicants should receive clear information before applying for public housing support.
合格申请者在申请公共住房支持前应获得清晰信息。

qualified.zh: 合格的；有资格的；有限度的
example: Qualified teachers are essential in mixed-ability classrooms with different learning needs.
在有不同学习需求的混合能力课堂中，合格教师至关重要。
No country can eradicate poverty without education, healthcare, stable jobs, and housing.
没有教育、医疗、稳定工作和住房，任何国家都无法根除贫困。
An eloquent speech cannot justify a policy without evidence, funding, and planning.
没有证据、资金和规划，雄辩演讲无法证明政策合理。
New problems may emerge gradually when cities expand without careful planning or funding.
当城市在没有谨慎规划或资金的情况下扩张时，新问题可能逐渐出现。
New risks arise when patients trust online symptoms more than professional doctors.
当患者更相信网络症状而不是专业医生时，新风险会出现。
Public transport plays a prominent role in reducing pressure on crowded roads.
公共交通在减轻拥挤道路压力方面发挥突出作用。
Empathy training can help doctors communicate better with anxious patients and families.
共情训练可以帮助医生更好地与焦虑患者和家属沟通。
Compassionate care is especially important for older patients living alone after retirement.
有同情心的护理对退休后独居的老年患者尤其重要。
Empirical evidence is needed before governments reform national education systems widely nationwide.
政府在全国范围内广泛改革国家教育体系之前，需要实证证据。
Evidence-based medicine protects patients from rumours, panic, and unsafe treatments online.
循证医学保护患者免受网络谣言、恐慌和不安全治疗的影响。
Digital platforms can enable access to education for remote communities and poor families.
数字平台可以让偏远社区和贫困家庭获得教育机会。
Public libraries can facilitate access to digital learning tools for poor families.
公共图书馆可以便利贫困家庭获取数字学习工具。
Small businesses may encounter difficulties when regulations change too quickly and frequently.
当规定变化过快且频繁时，小企业可能遇到困难。
Governments must confront inequality when rural hospitals lack doctors, equipment, and funding.
当农村医院缺乏医生、设备和资金时，政府必须面对不平等。
Mixed classes can encourage participation when teachers prevent labeling, exclusion, and shame.
当教师防止标签化、排斥和羞辱时，混合班可以鼓励参与。
Clear goals can motivate students to read more difficult English texts regularly.
清晰目标可以激励学生定期阅读更难的英文文本。
Counterfeit medicine can endanger public health in poorer communities with limited hospitals.
假药会危及医院有限的贫困社区的公共健康。
Ignoring building standards can jeopardize safety in densely populated cities and schools.
忽视建筑标准会危及高密度城市和学校中的安全。
Low-income families endure pressure when rent and food prices rise together.
当房租和食品价格同时上涨时，低收入家庭承受压力。
Public services must withstand pressure during economic crises, floods, and natural disasters.
公共服务必须在经济危机、洪水和自然灾害中承受压力。
Transparent budgets can enhance public trust before costly infrastructure projects begin construction.
透明预算可以在昂贵基础设施项目开工前增强公众信任。
International events can create enormous costs for cities with limited public budgets.
国际赛事会给公共预算有限的城市造成巨大成本。
Public hospitals face immense pressure when ageing populations grow rapidly and continuously.
当老龄化人口快速且持续增长时，公立医院面临巨大压力。
Governments should ensure equal access to education for rural and urban children.
政府应确保城乡儿童平等获得教育。
Laws should guarantee basic rights even when technology changes quickly and unpredictably.
即使技术快速且不可预测地变化，法律也应保障基本权利。
Hosting international events can entail costs that last long after the games.
举办国际赛事可能涉及在赛事结束很久后仍持续存在的成本。
Urban redevelopment should involve local residents before construction begins in their neighbourhoods.
城市改造应在居民所在社区开工前让当地居民参与。
The entire system becomes fragile when hospitals lack staff, beds, and equipment.
当医院缺乏人员、床位和设备时，整个系统会变得脆弱。
The whole society benefits when public transport becomes cheaper, cleaner, and safer.
当公共交通更便宜、更清洁且更安全时，整个社会都会受益。
Equitable access to healthcare should not depend on where a person lives.
公平获得医疗不应取决于一个人住在哪里。
Fair treatment helps older workers remain active in the labour market for longer.
公平待遇帮助老年劳动者更长久地在劳动力市场中保持活跃。
Comparable data helps researchers judge whether different cities face similar housing problems.
可比较数据帮助研究者判断不同城市是否面临相似住房问题。

erratic.zh: 不稳定的；不规律的；反复无常的
example: Erratic demand makes it difficult for local farmers to plan production and income.
不稳定需求让当地农民难以规划生产和收入。

irregular.zh: 不规则的；不规律的；非正式的
example: Irregular income can make rent, childcare, and healthcare costs harder to manage.
不稳定收入会让房租、育儿和医疗成本更难管理。
Reliable healthcare is an essential service for ageing societies and remote communities.
可靠医疗是老龄化社会和偏远社区的基本服务。

indispensable.zh: 不可或缺的；必不可少的
example: Qualified teachers play an indispensable role in mixed-ability classrooms and rural schools.
合格教师在混合能力课堂和农村学校中发挥不可或缺的作用。
Governments should establish clear standards before expanding online healthcare services nationwide for patients.
政府在为患者全国扩展线上医疗服务之前，应建立清晰标准。
Local leaders may found an institution to support vocational training and employment.
地方领导者可能创立机构来支持职业培训和就业。
Cities should estimate costs carefully before hosting international sporting events and building stadiums.
城市在举办国际体育赛事和建设体育场之前，应谨慎估算成本。
Early figures may only approximate the cost of transport projects and stadiums.
早期数字可能只能粗略估算交通项目和体育场的成本。
Online healthcare raises ethical questions about privacy, consent, and professional responsibility for doctors.
线上医疗引发关于隐私、同意和医生专业责任的伦理问题。
Advertisers have a moral responsibility not to target children with unhealthy food.
广告商有道德责任，不应以不健康食品针对儿童。
A costly stadium may eventually become useless if no long-term plan exists.
如果没有长期规划，昂贵体育场最终可能变得无用。
Public reform ultimately depends on funding, trust, careful implementation, and public support.
公共改革最终取决于资金、信任、谨慎执行和公众支持。
The lack of doctors is evident in many rural hospitals and clinics.
许多农村医院和诊所明显缺乏医生。
An apparent improvement in test scores may hide growing pressure on students.
考试分数的表面改善可能掩盖学生压力增加。
Images of polluted rivers can evoke public concern about environmental damage and health.
污染河流的图像可以引发公众对环境破坏和健康的担忧。
A clear explanation can elicit public support for difficult environmental reforms and costs.
清晰解释可以为困难的环境改革及其成本引发公众支持。
Exact figures are necessary before cities approve expensive public projects and stadiums.
城市批准昂贵公共项目和体育场之前，需要精确数字。
Precise data helps researchers compare pollution levels across different urban districts accurately.
精确数据帮助研究者准确比较不同城区的污染水平。
Politicians may exaggerate benefits when promoting costly international events to voters publicly.
政治人物在公开向选民宣传昂贵国际赛事时，可能夸大好处。
Companies often overstate the benefits of products in advertisements targeting young children.
公司常常在针对幼儿的广告中夸大产品好处。
Doctors should examine health risks carefully before recommending online treatment plans to patients.
医生在向患者推荐线上治疗方案之前，应仔细检查健康风险。
Authorities must inspect factories regularly to prevent unsafe working conditions and accidents.
当局必须定期检查工厂，以防止不安全工作条件和事故。
Construction costs often exceed the budget when cities rush preparations for events.
当城市仓促筹备赛事时，建设成本常常超出预算。
Online learning may surpass expectations when teachers receive proper training and support.
当教师获得适当培训和支持时，线上学习可能超出预期。
Exceptional talent still needs stable education, guidance, and long-term financial support.
杰出人才仍然需要稳定教育、指导和长期资金支持。
Extraordinary measures may be justified when public health is seriously threatened nationwide.
当全国公共健康受到严重威胁时，特殊措施可能合理。
Excessive credit card use can trap young consumers in long-term debt.
过度使用信用卡会让年轻消费者陷入长期债务。
Ranking students too early may create undue pressure and reduce their confidence.
过早给学生排名可能造成过度压力并降低他们的自信。
High fees may exclude poor families from quality healthcare and education services.
高费用可能把贫困家庭排除在优质医疗和教育服务之外。
Reports should not omit important details about public costs and long-term risks.
报告不应遗漏公共成本和长期风险的重要细节。
Patients may exhibit symptoms that require professional diagnosis, not online guessing or panic.
患者可能表现出需要专业诊断而不是网络猜测或恐慌的症状。
Museums can display cultural identity through objects, stories, and community voices effectively.
博物馆可以通过物品、故事和社区声音有效展示文化身份。
Cities should expand public transport before building more private car infrastructure downtown.
城市在市中心建设更多私家车基础设施之前，应扩大公共交通。
Governments may extend services to rural areas through digital platforms and local clinics.
政府可以通过数字平台和地方诊所把服务扩展到农村地区。
Digital records can expedite approval for medical reimbursement and public housing applications.
数字记录可以加快医疗报销和公共住房申请的审批。
Automation can accelerate economic growth while displacing some routine jobs in factories.
自动化可以加速经济增长，同时取代工厂中的一些常规岗位。
Public expenditure on stadiums should not reduce funding for hospitals and schools.
体育场上的公共支出不应减少医院和学校的资金。
Excessive spending on mega-events can weaken basic services for local residents.
大型赛事上的过度支出会削弱本地居民的基本服务。
Online platforms should obtain explicit consent before collecting sensitive medical data from users.
线上平台在收集用户敏感医疗数据之前，应获得明确同意。
Clear evidence helps citizens judge whether public spending is justified or wasteful.
清楚证据帮助市民判断公共支出是合理还是浪费。
Some companies exploit workers when labour laws are weakly enforced by authorities.
当劳动法被当局执行不力时，一些公司会剥削工人。
Schools can utilize technology to support students in remote rural areas effectively.
学校可以有效利用技术支持偏远农村地区的学生。
Investigative reports can expose corruption behind wasteful public projects and stadium deals.
调查报道可以揭露浪费性公共项目和体育场交易背后的腐败。
Extensive research is needed before governments redesign national exams and curricula nationwide.
政府在全国范围内重新设计全国考试和课程之前，需要广泛研究。
Broad support is necessary before cities spend heavily on stadiums and infrastructure.
城市在体育场和基础设施上大量花钱之前，需要广泛支持。
External funding can help poor schools buy digital learning tools and books.
外部资金可以帮助贫困学校购买数字学习工具和书籍。
Outer suburbs need reliable transport if cities want to reduce overcrowding downtown.
如果城市想减少市中心过度拥挤，外郊需要可靠交通。
Researchers must never fabricate evidence to make a weak policy argument appear stronger.
研究者绝不能编造证据，让薄弱的政策论证看起来更强。
Engineers may invent technology that reduces dangerous work in factories and mines.
工程师可能发明减少工厂和矿井危险工作的技术。
Factual accuracy is essential when media reports discuss crime or public health.
媒体报道犯罪或公共健康时，事实准确性至关重要。
Objective evidence helps citizens judge whether a costly project is worthwhile or wasteful.
客观证据帮助市民判断昂贵项目是值得还是浪费。
Public trust may falter when officials hide costs or ignore local concerns.
当官员隐瞒成本或忽视地方担忧时，公众信任可能动摇。
Public support may waver if transport reforms raise costs before benefits appear.
如果交通改革在收益出现前提高成本，公众支持可能动摇。
A feasible solution to traffic congestion must consider cost, land, and behaviour.
交通拥堵的可行解决方案必须考虑成本、土地和行为。
Remote work is a viable option when commuting costs become too high.
当通勤成本变得过高时，远程办公是可行选择。
Fertile land supports local food production and reduces dependence on imported grain.
肥沃土地支持本地食品生产，并减少对进口粮食的依赖。
Productive farmland can protect communities during disruptions in global food trade networks.
高产农田可以在全球食品贸易网络中断期间保护社区。
Fictitious accounts can distort online debates and mislead ordinary users about policy.
虚构账号会扭曲线上讨论，并误导普通用户对政策的看法。
Imaginary threats should not guide public policy without evidence or expert review.
没有证据或专家审查时，想象中的威胁不应指导公共政策。
A flawed system can exclude poor families from essential public services unfairly.
有缺陷的系统会不公平地把贫困家庭排除在基本公共服务之外。
Defective products can endanger consumers if safety inspections are weak or rare.
如果安全检查薄弱或稀少，缺陷产品可能危及消费者。
Food prices may fluctuate widely when countries depend heavily on imported supplies.
当国家严重依赖进口供应时，食品价格可能大幅波动。
Healthcare access may vary widely between urban centres and remote rural villages.
城市中心和偏远农村村庄之间的医疗可及性可能差异很大。
Foreseeable risks should be addressed before cities build expensive stadiums and roads.
城市建设昂贵体育场和道路之前，应处理可预见风险。
Predictable rules help businesses plan investment, hiring, training, and long-term growth.
可预测规则帮助企业规划投资、招聘、培训和长期增长。
Governments should formulate policy after examining evidence and consulting local communities carefully.
政府应在审查证据并仔细咨询当地社区后制定政策。
Teachers can devise a solution when students struggle with abstract vocabulary repeatedly.
当学生反复难以理解抽象词汇时，教师可以想出解决方案。
A fragile economy suffers quickly when food prices and energy prices rise together.
当食品价格和能源价格同时上涨时，脆弱经济会很快受损。
Vulnerable groups need stronger protection when healthcare becomes expensive or inaccessible nationwide.
当全国医疗变得昂贵或不可及时，弱势群体需要更强保护。
Frequent delays make public transport less attractive than private cars for commuters.
频繁延误让公共交通对通勤者而言不如私家车有吸引力。
Regular exercise can reduce health risks caused by sedentary work and screen time.
规律运动可以减少久坐工作和屏幕时间带来的健康风险。
Complex procedures can frustrate residents who need housing support quickly and urgently.
复杂程序会让急切需要住房支持的居民沮丧。
High costs can hinder access to healthcare for low-income families in rural areas.
高成本会阻碍农村低收入家庭获得医疗服务。
Education is a fundamental right, not a privilege for wealthy urban families.
教育是基本权利，而不是城市富裕家庭的特权。
Basic services should remain reliable even during economic crises and natural disasters.
即使在经济危机和自然灾害期间，基本服务也应保持可靠。
Tourism can generate income for local communities if profits are shared fairly.
如果利润被公平分享，旅游业可以为当地社区创造收入。
Local farms can produce food more reliably when soil and water are protected.
当土壤和水源受到保护时，本地农场可以更可靠地生产食物。
Gradual change may be easier for communities to accept than sudden reform.
渐进变化可能比突然改革更容易被社区接受。
Incremental reform can reduce resistance when policies affect daily commuting habits directly.
当政策直接影响日常通勤习惯时，渐进改革可以减少阻力。
Students can grasp a concept faster when examples come from familiar topics.
当例子来自熟悉话题时，学生能更快理解概念。
Air pollution poses a grave risk to children and older residents in cities.
空气污染对城市中的儿童和老年居民构成严重风险。
Serious illness should be diagnosed by doctors, not search engines or rumours.
严重疾病应由医生诊断，而不是由搜索引擎或谣言诊断。
Poor transport can hamper economic growth in small towns and rural areas.
糟糕交通会阻碍小城镇和农村地区的经济增长。
High fees can impede access to education for poor families in remote areas.
高费用会阻碍偏远地区贫困家庭获得教育。
Hazardous waste should not be dumped near schools, rivers, farmland, or homes.
危险废物不应倾倒在学校、河流、农田或住宅附近。
Dangerous roads can isolate rural residents from hospitals, schools, markets, and jobs.
危险道路会使农村居民与医院、学校、市场和工作隔绝。
Reports should highlight risks when projects may damage local communities or ecosystems.
当项目可能损害当地社区或生态系统时，报告应强调风险。
Teachers should emphasize evidence when students debate controversial social issues online together.
当学生一起在线讨论有争议的社会问题时，教师应强调证据。
Hostile debate can prevent communities from finding practical solutions to shared problems.
敌对辩论会阻碍社区找到共同问题的实际解决方案。
Antagonistic relationships between residents and officials can delay necessary urban reform for years.
居民和官员之间的对抗关系会让必要的城市改革延误多年。
A research hypothesis should be tested with data, not personal belief alone.
研究假设应由数据检验，而不是只靠个人信念。
A false assumption can lead policymakers to design ineffective and costly solutions.
错误假设会让政策制定者设计出无效且昂贵的方案。

idle.zh: 闲置的；无事可做的；懒散的
example: Idle stadiums can waste public money long after international events end completely.
国际赛事彻底结束很久后，闲置体育场仍会浪费公共资金。
Rising rents can ignite public anger in overcrowded cities with stagnant wages.
在工资停滞的拥挤城市中，房租上涨会激起公众愤怒。
Good teachers can kindle interest in reading through vivid stories and useful examples.
好老师可以通过生动故事和实用例子激发阅读兴趣。
Careful research can illuminate causes of urban stress beyond simple population growth.
细致研究可以阐明城市压力的原因，而不止是简单的人口增长。
An imminent crisis requires clear communication, rapid public action, and trusted institutions.
迫近危机需要清晰沟通、迅速公共行动和可信机构。
An impending shortage of doctors may worsen rural healthcare access for older residents.
即将发生的医生短缺可能恶化农村老年居民的医疗可及性。
Impartial assessment is needed when public money supports private companies and projects.
当公共资金支持私人公司和项目时，需要公正评估。
Neutral language helps teachers discuss controversial topics without pushing one view unfairly.
中性语言帮助教师讨论有争议话题，而不公平地强推某一观点。
Protecting patient privacy is imperative as online healthcare expands quickly across regions.
随着线上医疗在各地区快速扩展，保护患者隐私是迫切必要的。
Air pollution is an urgent problem for children in crowded industrial cities.
空气污染是拥挤工业城市中儿童面临的紧急问题。
Financial records may implicate officials in wasteful stadium contracts and hidden deals.
财务记录可能牵涉官员参与浪费性的体育场合同和隐性交易。
An implicit assumption about poverty can distort education policy and public debate.
关于贫困的隐含假设会扭曲教育政策和公共讨论。
Implied consent is risky when users do not understand data collection practices.
当用户不理解数据收集做法时，默示同意是有风险的。
Governments may impose fines on companies that dump hazardous waste near rivers.
政府可能对在河流附近倾倒危险废物的公司施加罚款。
Financial incentives can encourage companies to hire and train older workers effectively.
经济激励可以有效鼓励公司雇佣并培训老年员工。
Clear goals can increase learning motivation when students face difficult vocabulary repeatedly.
当学生反复面对困难词汇时，清晰目标可以增强学习动力。
Parents may be inclined to support mixed classes if teachers explain benefits clearly.
如果教师清楚解释好处，父母可能倾向支持混合班。
Residents may be disposed to cooperate when officials disclose costs honestly and early.
当官员早早诚实披露成本时，居民可能愿意合作。
Inclusive education can help weaker students learn without shame, isolation, or labels.
包容教育可以帮助较弱学生在没有羞耻、孤立或标签的情况下学习。
Economic growth and environmental protection are not necessarily incompatible long-term policy goals.
经济增长和环境保护并不一定是不相容的长期政策目标。
Conflicting interests often appear when cities plan new roads through old neighbourhoods.
当城市计划让新道路穿过老社区时，冲突利益常常出现。
Inconclusive evidence should not justify strict ability grouping in schools nationwide today.
如今无定论证据不应为全国学校严格按能力分班提供正当性。
An uncertain future makes families cautious about debt, childcare costs, and housing.
不确定未来让家庭对债务、育儿成本和住房更加谨慎。
Rising rents may indicate deeper problems in urban planning and labour markets.
房租上涨可能表明城市规划和劳动力市场存在更深层问题。
Survey results suggest a pattern of growing anxiety among young urban workers.
调查结果表明年轻城市劳动者的焦虑正在增长。
Alarmist headlines can induce anxiety among patients searching symptoms online alone at night.
耸动标题会让夜里独自在线搜索症状的患者产生焦虑。
A sudden fee increase can trigger public anger against transport authorities quickly.
突然涨价会迅速引发公众对交通部门的愤怒。

inevitable.zh: 不可避免的；必然发生的
example: Some job losses may be inevitable when factories adopt robots very quickly.
当工厂非常快速地采用机器人时，一些失业可能不可避免。
Some unavoidable costs should be explained before cities approve major public projects.
城市批准重大公共项目之前，应解释一些不可避免的成本。
Inferior service in rural hospitals can deepen health inequality over time significantly.
农村医院较差的服务会随着时间显著加深健康不平等。
Substandard housing can damage health, safety, and children's study conditions severely indoors.
低标准住房会在室内严重损害健康、安全和儿童学习条件。
Advertising can influence behaviour by linking products with status, happiness, and success.
广告可以通过把产品与地位、幸福和成功联系起来影响行为。
Noise pollution can affect health even when residents adapt to it gradually.
即使居民逐渐适应了噪音污染，它仍会影响健康。
Credit cards carry inherent risk when users lack financial literacy and discipline.
当用户缺乏金融素养和纪律时，信用卡带有固有风险。
Reading has intrinsic value beyond exam scores, certificates, job applications, and grades.
阅读具有超越考试分数、证书、求职申请和成绩的内在价值。
Initial investment in public transport can reduce long-term congestion costs significantly.
公共交通的初始投资可以显著降低长期拥堵成本。
Preliminary evidence should guide further research, not final policy decisions nationwide today.
如今初步证据应指导进一步研究，而不是全国最终政策决定。
Innovative technology can improve healthcare access in remote regions and villages effectively.
创新技术可以有效改善偏远地区和村庄的医疗可及性。
A novel approach to teaching can make vocabulary learning less painful and repetitive.
新颖教学方法可以让词汇学习不那么痛苦和重复。
Creator data can offer valuable insight into audience behaviour and platform incentives.
创作者数据可以提供关于受众行为和平台激励的宝贵洞察。
A deep understanding of users can improve digital public services significantly over time.
对用户的深刻理解可以随着时间显著改善数字公共服务。

integral.zh: 不可或缺的；完整的；积分的
example: Public transport is an integral part of making large cities more livable today.
公共交通是如今让大城市更宜居的不可或缺部分。
Medical advice should be intelligible to patients with limited education and anxiety.
医疗建议应让教育有限且焦虑的患者能够理解。
Laws should be written in comprehensible language so citizens understand their rights.
法律应以易懂语言书写，让市民理解自己的权利。
Intense competition for housing can push young workers out of city centres.
住房的激烈竞争会把年轻劳动者挤出市中心。
A severe shortage of doctors can leave rural patients without timely treatment.
严重的医生短缺会让农村患者无法获得及时治疗。
Students learn better when they interact with classmates instead of only watching videos.
当学生与同学互动而不是只看视频时，他们学得更好。
Local governments should engage with communities before redesigning neighbourhoods, roads, and parks.
地方政府在重新设计社区、道路和公园之前，应与社区互动。
Constant notifications can interfere with learning and reduce students' attention span significantly.
持续通知会严重干扰学习，并降低学生的注意力持续时间。
Trade conflicts can disrupt supply chains and raise food prices for ordinary families.
贸易冲突会扰乱供应链，并提高普通家庭的食品价格。
Internal conflict within agencies can delay public transport reform for many years.
机构内部冲突会让公共交通改革延迟许多年。
Inner city areas often face high rents, congestion, and limited green space.
内城区常常面临高房租、拥堵和有限绿地。
Fabricated data can invalidate an entire study and damage public trust permanently.
编造数据会使整项研究无效，并永久损害公众信任。
Clear evidence can disprove false claims about miracle health products quickly online.
清楚证据可以在线快速反驳关于神奇保健产品的虚假说法。
Journalists should investigate corruption before officials approve expensive public contracts secretly today.
如今记者应在官员秘密批准昂贵公共合同之前调查腐败。
Auditors should probe hidden costs before governments sign stadium contracts publicly today.
如今审计员应在政府公开签署体育场合同之前调查隐性成本。
Citizens may invoke legal rights when companies misuse personal data commercially online.
当公司在线商业化滥用个人数据时，市民可以援引合法权利。
Researchers should cite evidence rather than repeat popular assumptions about technology blindly.
研究者应引用证据，而不是盲目重复关于技术的流行假设。
Isolated communities need reliable roads, internet access, and medical services urgently today.
如今孤立社区迫切需要可靠道路、网络可及性和医疗服务。
Climate action requires joint effort from governments, companies, citizens, schools, and scientists.
气候行动需要政府、公司、市民、学校和科学家共同努力。
Shared responsibility makes environmental protection more realistic than blaming individuals alone today.
如今共同责任让环境保护比单独责怪个人更现实。
Clear benefits are needed to justify spending public money on mega-events.
需要明确收益来证明把公共资金花在大型赛事上是合理的。
Officials must defend a policy with evidence, not slogans, fear, or pressure.
官员必须用证据而不是口号、恐惧或压力为政策辩护。
Latent demand for healthcare may appear when clinics become more affordable locally.
当地方诊所变得更可负担时，医疗的潜在需求可能出现。
Hidden costs often make stadium projects more expensive than voters expect initially.
隐性成本常常让体育场项目比选民最初预期更昂贵。
Residents have legitimate concerns when redevelopment threatens homes and local businesses nearby.
当改造威胁附近住宅和本地商业时，居民有合理担忧。

valid.zh: 有效的；合理的；有根据的
example: Valid evidence should guide policy more than rumours or political pressure today.
如今有效证据应比谣言或政治压力更能指导政策。
Automation can liberate workers from dangerous tasks if protections are strong enough.
如果保护措施足够有力，自动化可以把工人从危险任务中解放出来。
Robots can free workers from repetitive tasks, but training remains necessary afterwards.
机器人可以把工人从重复性任务中解放出来，但之后培训仍然必要。

liable.zh: 有责任的；可能的；易于……的
example: Companies should be liable for damages when defective products harm consumers seriously.
当缺陷产品严重伤害消费者时，公司应对损害负责。
A responsible government should disclose costs before approving international events publicly today.
如今负责任政府应在公开批准国际赛事之前披露成本。

linger.zh: 逗留；持续存在；挥之不去
example: Debt can linger for years when credit card interest is extremely high.
当信用卡利息极高时，债务会持续多年。
Poverty may persist despite economic growth if resources are distributed unfairly nationwide.
如果资源在全国范围内分配不公平，即使经济增长，贫困也可能持续存在。
A literal translation can miss the real meaning of an English phrase.
字面翻译可能错过英文短语的真实含义。
A logical argument should connect evidence, causes, policy choices, and outcomes clearly.
合理论证应清楚连接证据、原因、政策选择和结果。
Rational policy should balance economic growth with environmental protection and social fairness.
合理政策应平衡经济增长、环境保护和社会公平。
Transparent budgets help governments maintain public trust during expensive infrastructure projects today.
如今透明预算帮助政府在昂贵基础设施项目期间维护公众信任。
Cities should preserve cultural heritage while improving housing, transport, and public space.
城市应在改善住房、交通和公共空间的同时保护文化遗产。
Housing costs are a major factor behind declining birth rates in cities.
住房成本是城市出生率下降背后的主要因素。
Reliable public transport can have a significant impact on urban quality of life.
可靠公共交通会对城市生活质量产生显著影响。

marginal.zh: 边缘的；微小的；不重要的
example: A marginal benefit cannot justify a project that drains public funds repeatedly.
微小收益无法证明一个反复耗尽公共资金的项目合理。

minor.zh: 较小的；次要的；未成年的
example: Minor issues can become serious when officials ignore them for many years.
当官员多年忽视小问题时，小问题可能变得严重。
Mega-events often require massive investment before uncertain benefits appear publicly later.
大型赛事往往在不确定收益后来公开出现前需要巨额投资。
A huge cost overrun can force cities to cut basic services suddenly.
巨大的成本超支会突然迫使城市削减基本服务。
Cities should maximize benefits from public projects by planning long-term use.
城市应通过规划长期使用来最大化公共项目收益。
Digital systems can optimize public services if data protection remains strong enough.
如果数据保护足够有力，数字系统可以优化公共服务。
Researchers should measure progress with outcomes, not political slogans alone today honestly.
如今研究者应诚实地通过结果而不是仅靠政治口号来衡量进展。
Community leaders can mediate disputes when redevelopment divides residents and officials sharply.
当改造使居民和官员严重分裂时，社区领袖可以调解争端。
Teachers can moderate discussion when students debate sensitive social issues together online.
当学生一起在线讨论敏感社会问题时，教师可以主持讨论。
A policy with minimal impact should not receive massive public funding today.
如今影响极小的政策不应获得大量公共资金。
A slight improvement in traffic cannot justify destroying valuable public parks downtown.
交通的轻微改善无法证明摧毁市中心宝贵公共公园是合理的。
Governments should not neglect rural areas while investing in glamorous city projects.
政府在投资光鲜城市项目时，不应忽视农村地区。
Officials should not ignore warnings about pollution near schools, homes, and hospitals.
官员不应忽视学校、住宅和医院附近污染的警告。
A notable improvement in buses can reduce car use among daily commuters.
公交的显著改善可以减少日常通勤者使用汽车。

remarkable.zh: 显著的；非凡的；值得注意的
example: Remarkable progress in healthcare requires investment beyond short-term political promises today.
如今医疗方面的显著进步需要超越短期政治承诺的投资。

obscure.zh: 模糊的；晦涩的；不出名的
example: Obscure rules make it harder for citizens to claim basic legal rights.
模糊规则让市民更难主张基本法律权利。
Unclear evidence should not justify expensive reforms affecting millions of students nationwide.
不清楚证据不应为影响全国数百万学生的昂贵改革提供正当性。
Teachers can observe behaviour to identify students who need extra support early.
教师可以观察行为，尽早识别需要额外支持的学生。
Parents may notice warning signs before children develop serious screen addiction gradually.
父母可能在孩子逐渐形成严重屏幕成瘾之前注意到警告信号。
The obvious problem is that housing costs rise faster than workers' wages.
明显问题是住房成本上涨速度快于工人工资。
Empty stadiums occupy valuable land that could serve local communities better today.
如今空置体育场占用本可以更好服务当地社区的宝贵土地。
Many species inhabit wetlands that are threatened by rapid urban expansion nearby.
许多物种栖息于受到附近快速城市扩张威胁的湿地。
Traffic accidents occur frequently when roads are poorly designed and maintained locally.
当地方道路设计和维护糟糕时，交通事故频繁发生。
Policy failures happen when leaders ignore evidence and local experience completely today.
如今当领导者完全忽视证据和地方经验时，政策失败就会发生。
Ongoing reform requires stable funding, public trust, and careful evaluation today nationwide.
如今全国范围内的持续改革需要稳定资金、公众信任和谨慎评估。
Continuous support helps older workers adapt to new technologies after retraining programs.
持续支持帮助老年劳动者在再培训项目后适应新技术。
A political opponent may criticize stadium spending to expose hidden public costs.
政治对手可能批评体育场支出，以揭露隐藏公共成本。
Commercial rivals may compete fiercely for data, users, and advertising revenue online.
商业竞争者可能在线为数据、用户和广告收入激烈竞争。
Ordinary people should not pay for projects that mainly benefit wealthy elites.
普通人不应为主要让富裕精英受益的项目买单。
A common problem in large cities is that rent rises faster than wages.
大城市中的常见问题是房租上涨快于工资。
Learning outcomes matter more than whether a class looks technologically advanced today.
如今学习结果比课堂看起来是否技术先进更重要。
Research results should be explained clearly before they influence national education policy.
研究结果在影响国家教育政策之前，应被清楚解释。
Obsolete equipment can prevent rural clinics from diagnosing patients accurately today locally.
如今地方农村诊所会因过时设备而无法准确诊断患者。
Overlapping responsibilities can make urban governance slow, confusing, and inefficient today locally.
如今地方上的重叠职责会让城市治理缓慢、混乱且低效。
Rising rents may coincide with job growth, but workers can still suffer.
房租上涨可能与就业增长同时发生，但工人仍可能受苦。
Citizens should participate in debate before governments approve costly stadium projects publicly.
政府公开批准昂贵体育场项目之前，市民应参与讨论。
Robots may replace routine jobs, but they cannot replace human judgement in complex services.
机器人可能取代常规工作，但无法取代复杂服务中的人类判断。
Online information cannot cure disease, but it may help patients ask better questions.
网络信息不能治愈疾病，但它可能帮助患者提出更好的问题。
An appropriate response to ageing requires healthcare reform, pension support, and flexible employment.
应对老龄化的适当回应需要医疗改革、养老金支持和灵活就业。

casual.zh: 随意的；临时的；非正式的
example: Casual workers often lack stable income, training opportunities, and legal protection in cities.
城市中的临时工往往缺乏稳定收入、培训机会和法律保护。
Excessive competition can damage students' psychological well-being and reduce their motivation.
过度竞争会损害学生心理健康，并降低他们的动力。
Researchers should replicate results before using them to reform national education policy.
研究者应在用结果改革国家教育政策之前复现结果。
Temporary solutions cannot solve housing shortages if cities ignore long-term planning.
如果城市忽视长期规划，临时方案无法解决住房短缺。
Vertical farming may reduce land pressure in crowded cities with limited farmland.
垂直农业可能减少耕地有限的拥挤城市中的土地压力。
Governments should weigh benefits and costs before hosting expensive international events publicly.
政府在公开举办昂贵国际赛事之前，应权衡利弊。
Flexible working hours can help parents balance employment and childcare responsibilities more effectively.
灵活工作时间可以帮助父母更有效地平衡就业和育儿责任。
Regular screening can detect disease earlier and reduce long-term medical costs.
定期筛查可以更早发现疾病，并降低长期医疗成本。
Intelligent systems can improve services only when designers understand real users deeply.
只有当设计者深入理解真实用户时，智能系统才能改善服务。

cater.zh: 迎合；满足需要；承办餐饮
example: Education systems should cater to different needs instead of forcing one standard path.
教育系统应满足不同需求，而不是强迫所有人走同一标准路径。
Online healthcare becomes complicated when patients cannot judge whether information is reliable.
当患者无法判断信息是否可靠时，线上医疗会变得复杂。
Public debate should focus on evidence, costs, long-term consequences, and fairness.
公共讨论应聚焦证据、成本、长期后果和公平。
Gross inequality can weaken social trust and reduce support for public reform.
严重不平等会削弱社会信任，并降低公众对公共改革的支持。
Cities should pilot a reform before applying it to millions of residents.
城市应先试行改革，再把它应用到数百万居民身上。
Credit cards make it easier to purchase goods before consumers can afford them.
信用卡让消费者在负担得起之前更容易购买商品。
Online registration can save time, but it may exclude older citizens from services.
在线登记可以节省时间，但可能把老年市民排除在服务之外。
Remote work can reduce commuting pressure but may weaken workplace relationships gradually.
远程工作可以减少通勤压力，但可能逐渐削弱职场关系。
Governments should not repeat costly mistakes when planning international events again publicly.
政府在再次公开规划国际赛事时，不应重复代价高昂的错误。
Online learning should not simply resemble a cheaper version of classroom teaching.
线上学习不应只是课堂教学的廉价版本。
Transparent investigations can restore public trust after serious corruption scandals emerge publicly.
透明调查可以在严重腐败丑闻公开出现后恢复公众信任。
A spectacular event may hide long-term costs that residents must pay.
壮观事件可能掩盖居民必须承担的长期成本。
Investment in public transport can yield benefits for workers and local businesses.
公共交通投资可以为劳动者和本地企业产生收益。
Punishment alone cannot reduce crime if poverty and unemployment remain severe locally.
如果当地贫困和失业仍然严重，单靠惩罚无法减少犯罪。
Youth unemployment can increase social instability if training opportunities remain limited nationwide.
如果全国培训机会仍然有限，青年失业会增加社会不稳定。
Stable employment allows families to plan housing, childcare, and retirement more confidently.
稳定就业让家庭更有信心规划住房、育儿和退休。
Environmental protection should be treated as a shared responsibility, not a personal hobby.
环境保护应被视为共同责任，而不是个人爱好。
Public investment in early education can reduce inequality across generations significantly nationwide.
早期教育的公共投资可以在全国范围内显著减少代际不平等。
Rehabilitation programmes can reduce reoffending when they combine training, counselling, and employment support.
当康复改造项目结合培训、咨询和就业支持时，它们可以减少再犯罪。
Affordable accommodation near universities can reduce commuting pressure and improve student well-being.
大学附近的可负担住宿可以减少通勤压力，并改善学生幸福感。
Academic achievement should not be measured only by exam scores and rankings.
学业成就不应只由考试分数和排名来衡量。
Road maintenance is often cheaper than repairing damage after years of neglect.
道路维护通常比多年忽视后再修复损坏更便宜。
Public health should remain a top priority when governments allocate limited budgets.
当政府分配有限预算时，公共健康应始终是首要任务。
Data security becomes essential when hospitals store personal information on digital platforms.
当医院在数字平台上储存个人信息时，数据安全变得至关重要。
Schools should foster creativity instead of training students to repeat fixed answers.
学校应培养创造力，而不是训练学生重复固定答案。
Cultural diversity can enrich cities when public services remain inclusive and accessible.
当公共服务保持包容和可及时，文化多样性可以丰富城市。
Technological innovation should solve real social problems rather than simply attract private investment.
技术创新应解决真实社会问题，而不是仅仅吸引私人投资。
A broader perspective helps policymakers see costs that simple statistics may hide.
更广视角帮助政策制定者看到简单统计可能隐藏的成本。
